description.html: One Year Guarantee View Details > Product Description Walk upright and pain-free with the Upright Rollator Walker from Vive Health. This stand up walker maintains proper posture while eliminating the neck, shoulder and back strain caused by hunching over traditional walkers. The standing walker for adults lets you look forward naturally while walking, providing the mobility support your body needs without forcing you to bend. Built with aircraft-grade aluminum, this walker with arm rest delivers dependable strength at just 20 pounds while supporting up to 300 pounds. The adult standing walker adjusts from 41 to 46 inches to fit users from 5'2" to 6'4". Responsive hand brakes control your speed on inclines and lock the wheels firmly when seated. This walker with chair and wheels features a padded 17.5-inch seat with backrest for comfortable rest stops. The standup walker collapses to 10.8 inches wide for fitting into car trunks and tight storage spaces. Eight-inch flat-free wheels on this upright walkers with seat handle indoor floors and outdoor paths without requiring air. A detachable shoulder bag holds 11 pounds of essentials and the integrated cane holder keeps your cane accessible. This adult walker combines clinical-grade construction with practical daily functionality, giving you the confidence to maintain an active lifestyle. Check out our collection of Rollators & Walkers to see more products like the 3-Wheel Walker Rollator and wheelchair walkers. One Year Guarantee View Details > Product Description The Upright Walker-Series T from Vive Mobility is designed to transform your mobility experience. Tailored for tall, bariatric and larger individuals, this heavy-duty walker supports up to 400 pounds and encourages a more natural walking posture. Unlike traditional walkers that cause you to stoop, the Series T helps you maintain an upright position, reducing shoulder and neck tension while allowing you to walk comfortably and look straight ahead. The more advanced adjustable hand supports of this model allow you to customize the width and length of the arms which range in height from 41 to 50 inches, to suit different, diverse body types and personal preferences. Ergonomically designed loop hand brakes which are positioned for easy control while going downhill and brakes that immobilize the wheels for secure resting are features of the generously padded seat and foam backrest. The unique combination guarantees you will feel secure and stable whether you are actively walking or resting during your activities. This upright rollator is made with lightweight but strong aluminum construction, which allows it to support 400 pounds while only weighing 25 pounds, making it very easy to navigate and transport. Whether dealing with mobility challenges, recovering from bariatric surgery, or shifting support, the Series T provides the strong support necessary to help you fully upright and assist in living and maintaining a very active and independent lifestyle.
